notes: Source of truth for registration edge cases. BA team can edit the Excel export (qa/tools/cases-io.js) and run it directly.
base: 'valid' merges the 'bases.valid' patient below, then 'input' overrides it. Use "" in input to clear a base field.

Tokens: {{seq}} agent test number (digits), {{seqWord}} the same number spelled out for name fields (digits are stripped there), {{phone}} unique valid mobile, {{phone2}} second unique mobile, {{today}} DD/MM/YYYY, {{first}} first dropdown option, {{regId@CASE}} / {{phone@CASE}} values from an earlier case.
expected.values / persisted: '*' = any non-empty, '' = empty, '~text' = contains, otherwise case-insensitive equality.
expected.assumed = true marks expectations that are NOT defined in code/config (requirement gap). Failures there are reported as 'FAIL (assumed requirement)'.
Outcomes: created | blocked | rejected | duplicate-warning | field-state | no-errors | found | not-found | no-error | updated | observe

requirements.title: Mandatory demographic & contact fields are enforced and persisted accurately on registration
Mobile, WhatsApp, Emergency phone numbers and Email addresses validate format, country rules and cross-field uniqueness
Patient names and titles preserve valid real-world punctuation, block invalid symbols/scripts and align with gender
Date of Birth and Age synchronize bidirectionally, support leap years and reject future or impossible human ages
PIN code forward/reverse lookup, state/district/city/area cascade and permanent address rules stay consistent
Payer Type, Payer and Sponsor enforce Self-Paid defaults and require explicit selection for Corporate and Insurance
Registration variants (New Born, International, Outside, Staff, Diagnostic) enforce variant-specific clinical and mandatory fields
Identity Type and Identity Number enforce conditional completeness and valid document attachment
Duplicate registrations and rapid double-submits are prevented without false success notifications
Global patient search locates records by UHID, Name and Mobile while safely escaping special regex characters
Existing patient updates track dirty state accurately, require remarks and enforce all mandatory and format validations
UI form transitions, type switches and field cascades reset stale values without premature validation errors
